title: AgentPRM: Process Reward Models for LLM Agents via Step-Wise Promise and Progress

rs.key_step: 以自身轨迹终局反馈bootstrap Q标签，同时拟合绝对Q和相邻Q差，约束promise与progress。
rs.why_non_obvious: 相邻差的监督改变value拟合几何，但差值只在特定确定性/稀疏设定对应advantage。
rs.trigger_condition: When independent step values omit local progress, jointly fit values and their adjacent differences using bootstrapped trajectory labels.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When independent step values omit local progress, jointly fit values and their adjacent differences using bootstrapped trajectory labels.

signatures.information: 终局稀疏奖励、轨迹、前后state-action与自身bootstrap估值
signatures.operation: L=L_Q+beta L_A，L_A拟合预测Q差和标签Q差；推理BoN/beam选动作
signatures.claimed_effect: Qwen2.5-3B beam8×8 WebShop PVM54.5→AgentPRM76.0；TextCraft44.3→56.7；TD标注tokens是MC的1/1.9 WebShop、1/2.8 BabyAI。
signatures.failure_boundary: 未保证proxy在更新actor或不同转移分布上校准；2×2时0.5B BabyAI82.9低于PVM84.6。

relevance.how: 用相邻Q差训练过程评估，启发动作级信号但不是crop必要性证明。
强调必要绕路不能仅凭离目标近远判错。
